posts.title: When do you have to repeat redundant sizes attributes within a <picture>?
posts.description: TL;DR Almost always, but that might be changing . Okay, so— Let’s say you’ve got a <picture> element that includes multiple candidate sources. If you’re doing art direction , those sources are probably each going to be laid out differently. This means they’ll each need their own sizes attribute. <picture> <!-- landscape image over text --> <source media= "(min-width: 600px)" srcset= "landscape-lg.

posts.title: I finished a 50K
posts.description: In June I ran the Orcas Island 50K . When I finished the race I also finished a 2+ year journey, which I’d started, in part, because I was staring down 40-years-old and had feelings about aging and my body .
